name: ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets
name_zh: ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets
desc: A ChatGPT sidebar inside Excel and Google Sheets for spreadsheet work.
desc_zh: Excel 和 Google Sheets 侧边栏里的 ChatGPT，专管表格里的活。
solves: Formulas and cleanup get pasted back and forth until the file breaks. The add-in works on the workbook where it already is, and the result stays editable.
solves_zh: 公式和清理结果来回粘贴，文件很容易被改坏。这个加载项就在原来的工作簿里干活，产出仍然可以编辑。
best_for: A tracker or budget model needs building, updating, or explaining.
best_for_zh: 要新建、更新或者看懂一张跟踪表或预算模型。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes and OpenAI news）。 Beta announced 2026-03-05; global availability recorded in the release notes under the "May 5, 2026" heading. Missing from the ledger partition list, so it is a new entry. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在表格软件侧边栏里的 ChatGPT，与账本对 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-excel
